span.p:
__bmi: height_cm / 100 → m
bmi = round(weight / m², 2)
the /100 fix: cm² made every BMI ≈ 0

div.style: color: rgb(13, 42, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
BMI_RULES interval table — rule_target.py:13
<18.5 過輕 → cal 35
18.5–24 標準 → cal 30
24–27 過重 → cal 45
27–30 輕度肥胖 → cal 40
30–35 中度肥胖 → cal 35
≥35 重度肥胖 → cal 35
water = 30 · exercise = 1000 in every band

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
returns dict(result) — a copy,
so callers cannot mutate the rule table

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
HealthTarget.update_or_create(uid=member)
calories_intake = round(cal × weight)
water_intake = round(water × weight)
exercise_duration = exercise
end_time = today + TARGET_DURATION_DAYS(60)
